questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to conditions on or near the road. They are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about work zones. This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road. Drive with extra caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is one-way. Do not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign is diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. It tells you a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you to keep right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about work zones. This sign alerts you that a construction zone is starting. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: This is a diamond-shaped warning sign with black markings on a yellow background. It tells you that pedestrians may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings tells you a playground is nearby. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign means you are driving the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on collision. Carefully turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns of a curve ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a T intersection ahead. A road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed limit for leaving a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Drive carefully where people may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead makes a sharp turn. Slow down as much as you would at an intersection before you reach the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: The right lane is ending ahead. Be prepared to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.
There is a stop sign ahead.
There is a caution sign ahead.
You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Even on a green light, drivers turning left must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: From this lane, you may either turn right or go straight ahead. You have two options.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: These parking spaces are reserved only for drivers with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are trucks hauling gravel ahead.
The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
questions.explanation: The road ahead has loose gravel. Drive slowly and carefully because your tires will not grip the road as well.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Trucks are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: The road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden stops or turns, and keep more distance between your vehicle and the one ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicycles may be present in this area. Watch for them and be prepared to share the road.
